The BASS overview of ISS results (PSI-26_Presentations_BASS_Overview of Recent ISS Results.pdf, p31) does, for the Nomex III sample at 22% O2 and 14 cm/s: 'Flame was shrinking in width until it extinguished within 1 cm of the end of the sample, as its width became smaller than ~ 1 cm'. Read as going out at steady flow, as run 5b; digest finding [PSI-26 F9]. The pre-flight test matrix (PSI-26_Engineering Documents_BASS_SysAcceptanceReview.1.pdf, p41) planned test 14 as Nomex HT90-40; the experiment table and p31 say Nomex III.
